home.title: Akwụkwọ ndetu ụlọ ọrụ gị
home.trying: Ị na-anwale Glazecalc dịka {name}. Malite site n'usoro.
home.welcomeBack: Gaa n'ihu site n'ebe ị kwụsịrị.

welcome.heading: Nnọọ na Glazecalc
welcome.text: Akwụkwọ ndetu gị adịla njikere. Ezigbo nzọụkwụ mbụ: pịnye glaze ị na-agwakọta ugbu a, ihe eji arụ ya na ọnụọgụ ha, ma hụ unity formula ya.
welcome.confirm: Kwado email gị: anyị zigara njikọ na {email}. Ịbanye n'usoro abụọ chọrọ ya. <account>Ibe akaụntụ</account> gị nwere ike iziga ya ọzọ.
welcome.confirmText: Anyị zigara njikọ na {email}. Mepee ya iji kwado na adreesị ahụ bụ nke gị: ịbanye n'usoro abụọ chọrọ ya. <account>Ibe akaụntụ</account> gị nwere ike iziga ya ọzọ.

recipe.title: Usoro glaze
recipe.text: Wuo glaze site n'ihe eji arụ ọrụ na ọnụọgụ ha, hụ unity formula ya, ma chekwaa ya.

import.title: Mado usoro
import.text: Mado usoro site na weebụsaịtị, spreadsheet ma ọ bụ ihe edere, lelee ihe a gụrụ, ma chekwaa ha.

blends.title: Ngwakọta maka test tile
blends.text: Gwakọta usoro gị abụọ, atọ ma ọ bụ anọ ka ha bụrụ test tile nwere nọmba, ya na ihe ị ga-atụ maka nke ọ bụla.

material.title: Ihe eji arụ ọrụ
material.text: Tinye ihe eji arụ ọrụ nke gị, site na formula kemịkalụ ma ọ bụ nyocha onye na-ere ya.

additive.title: Ihe mgbakwunye na ihe na-enye agba
additive.text: Debe ihe na-enye agba na opacifier ị na-etinye n'elu glaze isi.

firing.title: Ndekọ ọkụ
firing.text: Dekọọ oge, okpomọkụ na cone maka ịgba ọkụ ọ bụla.

notes.title: Ihe edere
notes.text: Debe nsonaazụ nnwale na ihe ọ bụla ọzọ kwesịrị icheta.

advice.title: Ndụmọdụ glaze
advice.text: Ndụmọdụ maka ịgwakọta, itinye glaze na ịgba ọkụ, na ndụmọdụ nke gị.

guides.title: Ntuziaka
guides.text: Site n'ihe glaze bụ ruo n'ịgba ya ọkụ, na idebe onye ọ bụla n'udo n'ụzọ.

trash.title: Ebe mkpofu
trash.text: Weghachi ihe ị wepụrụ n'ime ụbọchị 30 gara aga.

account.title: Akaụntụ na ntọala
account.text: Ntọala, okwuntughe gị, ịbanye n'usoro abụọ, na ibudata ihe niile ị debere ebe a.

home.newHere: Unity formula ọ dị gị ọhụrụ? <advice>Ibe ndụmọdụ</advice> na-akọwa isi ihe, <about>ibe gbasara anyị</about> na-akọkwa otu Glazecalc si arụ ọrụ.

trash.title: Ebe mkpofu
trash.lead: Ihe ị wepụrụ (usoro, ihe eji arụ ọrụ, ihe mgbakwunye, ihe edere, ndekọ ọkụ na ndụmọdụ) na-echere ebe a ụbọchị 30. Weghachi ya, ma ọ bụ hichapụ ya kpamkpam.
